features.name: Evocation Savant
features.desc: You copy Evocation spells in half the time and for half the gold.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.desc: When you cast an Evocation spell with an area, you protect 1 + the spell's level allies: they automatically succeed on the saving throw and take no damage.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.desc: A creature that succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip still takes half damage.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.desc: You add your Int modifier to one damage roll of any Evocation spell.

features.name: Overchannel
features.desc: You cast a level 1-5 spell with maximum damage; after the first time per rest, you take increasing damage yourself.
